items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Yes I did an album with Ken Hanna had quite a few solos actually to play on that album, and that was a good band, a local band.

ctx.x: Well they don’t really know. So many motion pictures are being made right now, this is a very busy field, that’s one of the busiest things in this town, they’re making a lot of motion pictures. Lots of them. And almost all of them, every one I see, a lot of it is electric music. And then conversely, they’ll have hundred-piece orchestras on some of them. So I don’t know.
Let me ask you about some of the records you’ve been on. Early 50s, with Ken Hanna?
